sum: Robin Energy Ltd., a shipping company, acquires, owns, charters, and operates oceangoing LPG carrier vessels and tankers worldwide. The company provides seaborne transportation services for crude oil and refined petroleum products. As of December 31, 2025, it operates and maintains a fleet of two LPG carrier vessels and one tanker vessel with an aggregate cargo carrying capacity of 0.05 million deadweight tons. Robin Energy Ltd. was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Limassol, Cyprus.
